title: A simple protocol to isolate a single human cell PRDX1 knockout generated by CRISPR-Cas9 system
protocol: Grow cells in complete media (DMEM Glutamax supplemented with 5% Penicillin streptomycin and 10% FBS).
Harvest a minimum of 2 × 106 cells for RNA extraction.
Wash the cells with PBS.
Trypsinize with 1 mL of Tryp-LE to cover the surface of the cells.
Stop the trypsin enzymatic activity with an equal volume of complete culture medium.
Pellet cells using a clinical centrifuge at 201×g for 5 mins in Eppendorf centrifuge 5810.
Discard the supernatant and extract total RNA from the cell pellet using RNeasy mini kit as per the supplier protocol.
Quantify the RNA yield using Nanodrop.
Prepare cDNA using Agilent cDNA synthesis kit with 2 μg of total RNA.
Set up RT-PCR reaction to check for target gene expression.
Prepare reactions in triplicates for target gene amplification.
Prepare reactions in triplicates for housekeeping gene amplification (GADPH or ACT1).
Set up PCR reaction using 2 μL of cDNA for amplification of the targeted region.
Use Accuprime high fidelity DNA polymerase for amplification.
Check PCR amplification using a 1% agarose gel pre-stained with SYBR-SAFE dye.
Phosphorylate complementary oligos for each guide (Forward and Reverse).
Mix complementary pair of oligos in a final volume of 50 μL at a concentration of 140 nM for each oligo.
Incubate PCR tubes at 95°C for 10 minutes in a thermomixer.
Reset temperature to 25°C to allow annealing of the oligos.
Digest 10 μg of PX330_U6-Chimeric_BB_CBh-hSpCas9 plasmid with BbsI for 2 hours.
Run the digested plasmid on a 1% agarose gel.
Purify the linear plasmid backbone using QIAEX II gel extraction kit.
Ligate 50 ng of purified digest plasmid with 1, 2, or 4 μL of annealed primers in a ligation reaction with T4 ligase in a final volume of 10 μL.
Incubate the ligation reaction at 16°C for 16–18 hours.
Transform 3 μL of the ligation reaction into E. coli TOP10 bacteria according to the manufacturer's protocol.
Plate all transformation mix (∼150 ul) onto LB agar plates containing ampicillin (100 μg/mL).
Incubate the plates at 37°C for 16–18 hours.
Pick at least 10 colonies and inoculate them into 5 mL of LB medium with ampicillin (100 μg/mL).
Grow the cultures for 16-18 hours.
Extract plasmid DNA using a mini prep kit.
Store 100 μL of the culture for maxi prep with an endotoxin-free Qiagen kit.
Identify positive clones by DNA Sanger sequencing using forward and reverse primers.
Subculture 100 μl of stored culture carrying the correct plasmid PX330 into 100 ml of LB with Amp for Maxi prep Endotoxin free isolation.
Coat 24-well plate with 500 μL of 0.1% sterile filtered gelatin for 10 minutes at 37°C and dry the wells by aspirating the gelatin.
Cultivate HEK293 cells to 80% confluency in complete media.
Collect HEK293 cells by trypsinization using TrypLE, resuspend in DMEM with 10% FBS without antibiotics, and count cells using a cell counter.
Seed approximately 80,000 living cells in 500 μL of media into a coated 24-well plate.
Allow cells to adhere for 16-18 hours.
The next day, prepare the transfection master mix by mixing 2 μL of pCas9-gRNA-PRDX1 (500 ng/μL), 20 μL of Opti-MEM, and 3.4 μL of Fugene HD.
Incubate the transfection mixture for 7 minutes at 22°C–25°C.
Add the final master mix to each well in the plate and shake gently by hand.
Incubate the plate at 37°C for 48-72 hours.
After 2-3 days, collect cells from each well by trypsinization.
Centrifuge the collected cells.
Resuspend the cells in 1 mL of complete DMEM GlutaMax media.
Save some of the cells (approximately 1,000 cells) for isolating single cell colonies with potential PRDX1 knockout.
Centrifuge the remaining cells to prepare them for extracting genomic DNA using the Quick Extract DNA extraction kit.
Use extracted genomic DNA to verify and calculate gene editing efficiency through T7EI assay.
Use pSpCas9(BB)-2A-GFP (PX458: Addgene# 48138) to monitor transfection efficiency and perform specific genome editing with gRNA.
Design and synthesize three guide RNAs (pgRNA-1-PRDX1-Cas9, pgRNA-2-PRDX1-Cas9, pgRNA-3-PRDX1-Cas9) for PRDX1 knockout in HEK293 cells using CRISPR-Cas9 system.
Transfect HEK293 cells with the designed guide RNAs and Cas9 protein or plasmid.
Perform T7EI assay to assess gene editing efficiency in transfected and untransfected cells.
Extract genomic DNA from transfected cells using Quick Extract DNA.
Use 1 μL of extracted genomic DNA as a template for amplification.
Amplify PRDX1 gene with a pair of primers to generate a fragment of 703 bp.
Follow the instructions of Accuprime High fidelity enzyme provided by manufacturer.
Load 5 μL of PCR reaction onto a 1% agarose gel pre-stained with SYBER safe.
Purify the remaining PCR reaction using QIAGEN PCR purification kit.
Elute the purified PCR product using 35 μL of DNase/RNase free H2O.
Quantify the concentration of PCR amplified DNA using Nanodrop.
Normalize the concentration of PCR amplified DNA to 12 ng/μL.
Prepare the reaction for the T7EI assay.
Denature the total reaction according to Table 5 conditions.
Renature the denatured reaction according to Table 5 conditions.
Digest the renatured reaction with T7 endonuclease (T7EI) according to Table 5 conditions.
Incubate the digestion reaction at 37°C for 1 hour.
Add 6 μL of DNA loading dye to the reaction.
Load the entire content onto a 2% agarose gel.
Run the gel until the bands are well separated, typically 1 hour at 110 V.
Adjust the exposure time properly when imaging the gel so that none of the bands is saturated.
Estimate gene editing activity using ImageJ software.
Calculate the percentage of alleles showing evidence of NHEJ from band intensities according to Lee et al. (2017).
Confirm gene editing efficiency and specificity by Sanger sequencing using Topo-TA cloning kit and M-13 forward and reverse primers.
Count the transfected cells and serially dilute the cells in culture media to achieve a final concentration of 1,000 cells/mL.
Dispense 100 μL of cell suspension (∼100 cells) into 150 mm tissue culture plates.
Top up the plates with enough volume (25 mL) of complete culture media.
Incubate the plates for 10–15 days to form visible and separate colonies.
Pick up visible colonies by 10 μL pipette with 5 μL of TrypLE.
Avoid cross contamination by picking only well-separated colonies.
Transfer each of 24 single colonies into separate wells of a 24 well plate for expansion.
Expand the single colonies further by transferring the cells to 6-well plates.
Store some expanded single colonies in storage media (50% FBS, 40% DMEM-GlutaMax, 10% DMSO).
Collect some cells for genomic DNA extraction using the Quick Extract DNA extraction kit.
Purify the PCR product and proceed with Sanger sequencing to identify the type of mutation.
Harvest enough cells from a culture dish or T75 flask at 70–80% confluency.
Discard the culture media and wash twice with 1× PBS.
Add 1 mL of TrypLE to trypsinize the cells and incubate at 37°C for 1–2 minutes.
Add 5–10 mL media to collect the cells.
Transfer the collected cells to a 15 mL tube.
Centrifuge at 201×g for 3 minutes in Eppendorf centrifuge 5810.
Discard the supernatant.
Add 200 μL of ice-cold RIPA lysis buffer supplemented with 1% of 100 × Protease Inhibitors.
Mix gently by pipetting up and down.
Incubate on ice for 5 minutes.
Transfer the lysate to a pre-chilled micro-centrifuge tube.
Sonicate twice at 40% amplification for 5 seconds.
Clean the sonication probe with dH2O before and after every use.
Let the samples chill on ice between sets.
Ensure the sample is fully submerged without letting the probe touch the sides or bottom of the tube.
Centrifuge the tubes at 9,391×g for 10 minutes at 4°C in an Eppendorf microcentrifuge 5424R.
Transfer the supernatant to a new micro-centrifuge tube.
Keep the samples on ice.
Quantify proteins using Pierce BCA protein assay kit (Thermo Fisher).
Mix 20–30 μg of your protein with 4 μL 5 × Laemmli loading buffer and up to 20 μL dH2O in a microcentrifuge tube.
Place the tube on a thermal mixer at 95°C for 5 minutes to denature the proteins.
Load 3 μL of the ladder followed by 20 μL from each sample into each well of a 12.5% Acrylamide gel.
Run the gel at 90 V for 130 minutes.
Transfer proteins to a nitrocellulose membrane in Transfer Buffer using Trans-Blot Turbo Transfer System at 1.3 A and 25 V for 10 minutes.
Wash the membrane with distilled water to remove any gel residue.
Block the membrane in 5% milk 1 × TBST for 30 minutes.
Incubate the membrane with rabbit anti-PRDX1 primary antibody at a dilution of 1:2,000 overnight at 4°C.
Wash the membrane three times with 1× TBST, each wash lasting 10 minutes.
Incubate the membrane with anti-rabbit HRP secondary antibody at a dilution of 1:5,000 for 1 hour at room temperature (22-25°C).
Wash the membrane three times with 1 × TBST, each wash lasting 10 minutes.
Visualize using Pierce™ ECL Western Blotting Substrate.
Transform Topo-TA cloning product into Top10 competent bacteria.
Select colonies on solid LB + Kanamycin plates at 50 μg/mL or on solid LB + Ampicillin at 100 μg/mL.
Inoculate five selected colonies into 5 mL of LB + Kanamycin at 50 μg/mL.
Extract plasmid DNA using a Qiagen mini prep kit.
Perform Sanger sequencing using M-13 primers.
Analyze the DNA sequence using SnapGene or another suitable software.
